summary.intent: Assess Callisto's road to v1 (codebase, architecture, semantic model, competitors), find system-level gaps from the last week's PRs, then implement the fixes and package them into logical, reviewable commits/PR stacks.
summary.outcome: Identified and reproduced multiple cross-layer defects (E281 release-PR JSON mismatch, tag-based retry skipping, Python version decoding, multi-manifest ecosystem handling, etc.), implemented fixes with full CI green (1,861 tests, ~93.4% coverage), and committed T11, the T01 guard, and the D01 architecture packet locally. Nothing has been pushed and no PR opened; the broader implementation still needs hunk-level commit splitting.

repo: Callisto models one directory as one package with multiple canonical manifests and native release identities, but several paths (cascade rewrites, lockfile refresh, publish ordering) still assume one ecosystem per package.

The Release workflow's E281 failure came from #166 wrapping `release-pr decide` JSON in the shared envelope (command/dryRun) while `release-pr verify --decision` strictly rejects unknown fields; the binary contract test never piped decide into verify.
Bare local `callisto release` selects packages by tag absence, so a created-but-unpushed tag makes retries report 'Nothing to release'; CI's durable path keeps the committed roster and avoids this.
Python stable versions like 1.0.1 are valid SemVer and PEP 440, so decision decoding (SemVer) and manifest readers (PEP 440) produce unequal typed versions, causing E165/E037 failures.
Owner policy: Callisto never inspects, suppresses, rewrites or rejects package-owner npm lifecycle hooks; native package-manager behavior is preserved and hooks are trusted repo code.
Owner policy: E121 partial-run guard stays fail-closed with no automatic deletion of pre.json or persisted apply checkpoint; improve guidance instead.

Full `just ci` in the sandbox needs UV_CACHE_DIR, a fixture-local CARGO_HOME, and a cargo-deny advisory-db path redirected to temp dirs; actionlint, real-binary release-PR contract, and artifact preflight are outside `just ci`.
npm partial versions like `1.2` are X-ranges (1.2.x), not tilde ranges; shared normalization was corrected with an upper-bound regression.
Commit workflow requires the user to confirm each exact commit message and file set; `.git` is read-only in the sandbox so commits/staging need an elevated exception.

code.finding: derive_unreleased_decision skips every package whose current version already has a tag (including local tags), hiding unfinished push/GH release/remaining registry work on retry.
verify's strict decision input type rejects the envelope fields emitted by decide (line 79), producing E281.
Shared dependency-rewrite helper picks ecosystem from the display ID rather than the dependency edge's manifest, causing E017 after display-ID promotion.
Lockfile refresh selects one ecosystem per bump, leaving secondary ecosystem lockfiles (e.g. npm in a Cargo/npm package) stale.
Apply stages outputs then `git rm --cached` inputs before unlinking; a staging failure leaves pre.json plus staged stable outputs that trip check_partial_run (E121).
Tag prerequisites include only one registry identity's publishes, so a shared tag/GH release can complete before the second registry publish in dual-manifest packages.
Root package changelog path `./CHANGELOG.md` differs from Git's `CHANGELOG.md`, so valid version commits fail E165.
Generated napi build rows/placement visit every addon rather than release-intent-scoped ones.

friction: Entire transcript search unavailable due to missing authentication, so intent had to be reconstructed from PR descriptions.
Sandbox blocked writes to .git (index.lock), uv cache, ~/.cargo, and cargo-deny advisory DB, requiring elevated writes or redirected cache dirs.
The `callisto add` helper failed because the CLI rejected the repository's existing `[release]` config, forcing a hand-written changeset.
A T05 pre-exit guard change broke normal `pre exit` finalization tests until the state check was tightened.
First full CI run hit a Clippy too_many_arguments warning and a bad pnpm lockfile test assertion (link: vs registry version).
Repeated commit-confirmation prompts and shared-file overlap (apply.rs, version.rs, versioning.json) make hunk-level splitting laborious.
Codex text for an unrelated plugins repo was mixed into the session.
open_items: Split the remaining ~73 changed files into topic commits/PRs (T04/T05/schema/version-history/native deps etc.), then push and open PRs in dependency order.
Ship the E281 fix (verify accepts decide output as-is, plus decide→verify contract test and patch changeset) so #113 regenerates and 0.9.0 can release.
D01/ADR 12 remains Proposed and needs owner acceptance; migration details and wire/version-output contracts are still open.
Fix local retry selection so tagged packages still get remaining-step checks, and add shared publish barriers for dual-manifest packages.
Decide whether inference-only versioning augments or replaces changesets in release-PR automation.
Reconcile stale docs (architecture diagram, identity docs, ADR 11 'display-only' wording, README quick start, requirement doc on Cargo registry testing).
Historical identity transitions (rename, added manifest, sibling removal) still lose earlier release tags; inherited Cargo versions and root-package paths need historical resolution.
Run real fresh-repo onboarding to validate the 'first release under ten minutes' goal; thicker Cargo/PyPI end-to-end coverage; decide whether registry adoption needs checksums.
Revisit automatic pre.json recovery only if the staging-failure case recurs.
